name: claude-sandbox-scratch
goal: Keep Claude temporary files within the task scratch directory

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A sandboxed Claude launch fails creating /tmp/claude; pointing CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR to task scratch reaches initialization without changing the shared directory.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The process adapter had one unregistered connect case and no arguments method/state case. Declare its methods and initialization states; assert the provider-specific scratch variable in the arguments case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 3cc1cb4a3c, the two arguments state cases failed for both missing Claude scratch variables; eight other cases passed. Red de52006ab858 retained on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 8bb0cb31cb passes both Claude temporary variables to the provider inside the existing task scratch directory.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green dffd48add2c9 passes all 10 unchanged cases on the red profile. Mutant 86f2f16066c7 fails the same cases; identical restored tree passes 261cb11b4081.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
